insights: **Weekly Highlights —** PPC revenue jumped to $356 (+245.7%) and ROAS improved to 0.93x from 0.33x. The Epic 302 USB Headset grew to $154 (+50.0%) on 3 units (+50.0%), with sessions up +25.9% and conversion at 8.8%. The Crystal 2832 QD Headset and Epic 511 USB Headset both added sales, and Friday, Nov 20 was the peak day at $236.

**Metrics to Watch —** Total sales eased to $683 from $2,867 (-76.2%), driven almost entirely by the Crystal SR2831 ($158, -84.6%) and Epic 512 ($82, -90.0%) normalizing after an exceptionally strong prior week, which brought organic revenue to $326 (-88.2%). The paid side moved in the right direction, and the Crystal SR2831 is still converting at 11.8%. We are focused on rebuilding traffic to the Crystal SR2831 and Epic 512 to restore volume.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS improved to 0.93x from 0.33x on ad spend of $385 (prior $308), with ACOS at 108.1%, a 0.46% ad CTR and a 0.73% ad conversion rate. TACoS rose to 56.4% (prior 10.77%) because the total sales base was smaller this week. We are tightening targeting to push ROAS above 1.0x.

**Actions This Week —** Shift budget toward the Epic 302 (8.8% conversion) and Crystal 2832 (12.5% conversion) to scale the SKUs already converting. Launch targeted campaigns on the Crystal SR2831 to recover its -60.5% session drop. Cut search terms with clicks but no orders to bring ACOS below 108.1%, and test new ad creative to lift the 0.46% ad CTR.
